desc: 开襟易穿脱、水洗标外置、罗纹收口，婴幼儿贴身保暖两件套

name: 婴幼儿开襟保暖内衣套装款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的贴身套装主图
一秒讲清开襟设计穿脱方便的核心利益
放大套头衫勒头难穿的日常摩擦，反衬开襟的顺手
代入晨间更衣的育儿日常，营造柔软安心的氛围
用织纹与缝线的微距细节证明贴身做工
平铺展示整套形态与量法示意，消除尺码疑虑
并排陈列多色款，让买家从容选色
用外置水洗标与空吊牌位降低决策风险

style.backgroundSystem: clean cream white #FFFFFF for packshot and variant shots, soft apricot-cream panel #F6E7C9 for info, detail and trust shots
style.iconSystem: minimal thin-line infographic elements only, single honey-orange accent
style.lightingSystem: bright soft warm studio lighting, generous diffused front key with fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm gentle baby-clothing visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream white background #FFFFFF, apricot-cream panel #F6E7C9, honey-orange accent #E07B39 and warm charcoal text #4A4440; bright soft warm studio lighting with generous diffused fill and soft contact shadows; modern rounded geometric sans-serif; minimal thin-line infographic elements only where needed; clean soft baby-product photography with fabrics fresh and neatly pressed; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the set across the suite, folds always tidy and symmetrical
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale boards and warm oak nursery wood, fabrics always neatly pressed
